name: Orchestration Agent
purpose: Routes tasks, decomposes work, coordinates specialist agents, and assembles final responses.

name: Document Intelligence Agent
purpose: Reads plans, specifications, addenda, reports, contracts, manuals, and project files.

name: Takeoff Agent
purpose: Extracts measurable quantities and generates traceable takeoff records.

name: Estimating Agent
purpose: Creates estimate-ready line items, resource buildups, pricing scenarios, and assumptions.

name: Production Agent
purpose: Recommends crews, equipment spreads, production rates, durations, and fuel usage.

name: Risk Agent
purpose: Identifies scope gaps, conflicts, uncertainty, constructability risk, and commercial exposure.

name: Scheduling Agent
purpose: Generates sequencing, durations, constraints, and schedule-impact forecasts.

name: Project Management Agent
purpose: Supports RFIs, submittals, change events, budget forecasting, and progress controls.

name: Field Operations Agent
purpose: Analyzes daily reports, field production, photos, timecards, and job conditions.

name: Safety Agent
purpose: Supports JHAs/JSAs, hazard identification, training checks, and safety observations.

name: Fleet Agent
purpose: Optimizes assignments, utilization, maintenance forecasts, rental decisions, and fuel.

name: Procurement Agent
purpose: Compares quotes, lead times, vendor performance, substitutions, and buyout status.

name: CRM Agent
purpose: Scores leads, drafts communications, recommends follow-ups, and forecasts pipeline.

name: HR and Workforce Agent
purpose: Supports staffing, certification checks, training, attendance, and workforce planning.

name: Financial Intelligence Agent
purpose: Forecasts cash flow, profitability, cost-to-complete, and variance drivers.

name: Executive Agent
purpose: Produces executive summaries, KPI explanations, strategic alerts, and decision briefs.

name: Quality Agent
purpose: Supports inspections, punch lists, nonconformance review, and corrective actions.

name: Compliance Agent
purpose: Checks tenant policies, contract requirements, records retention, and regulatory controls.

name: Customer Portal Agent
purpose: Answers authorized customer questions using project-scoped, approved information.

name: Vendor and Subcontractor Agent
purpose: Supports onboarding, compliance, bid leveling, performance, and communication.
